proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ A B C D E hE hs hang
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hBA : B ≠ A := fun h => hs.2.1 (h ▸ left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  have hDC : D ≠ C := fun h => hs.2.2 (h ▸ right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  have hCA : C ≠ A := hE.right_ne
  have hu : B -ᵥ A ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hBA
  have hv : D -ᵥ C ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hDC
  have hw : C -ᵥ A ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hCA
  have hsum := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_eq_pi_of_angle_eq_pi B hE.angle₁₂₃_eq_pi
  have h1 : InnerProductGeometry.angle (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A) = InnerProductGeometry.angle (D -ᵥ C) (C -ᵥ A) := by
    have h2 : EuclideanGeometry.angle A C D = Real.pi - InnerProductGeometry.angle (D -ᵥ C) (C -ᵥ A) := by
      unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle
      rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C A, InnerProductGeometry.angle_neg_left, InnerProductGeometry.angle_comm]
    have h3 : EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = InnerProductGeometry.angle (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A) := rfl
    have h4 : EuclideanGeometry.angle E A B = EuclideanGeometry.angle B A E := EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm _ _ _
    linarith
  have hsgn : ((Module.Oriented.positiveOrientation (R := ℝ) (M := V) (ι := Fin 2)).oangle (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A)).sign =
      ((Module.Oriented.positiveOrientation (R := ℝ) (M := V) (ι := Fin 2)).oangle (D -ᵥ C) (C -ᵥ A)).sign := by
    have h5 := AffineSubspace.SSameSide.oangle_sign_eq (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) hs
    have h6 : ((Module.Oriented.positiveOrientation (R := ℝ) (M := V) (ι := Fin 2)).oangle (B -ᵥ A) (C -ᵥ A)).sign =
        (EuclideanGeometry.oangle B A C).sign := rfl
    have h7 : ((Module.Oriented.positiveOrientation (R := ℝ) (M := V) (ι := Fin 2)).oangle (D -ᵥ C) (C -ᵥ A)).sign =
        -(EuclideanGeometry.oangle D C A).sign := by
      unfold EuclideanGeometry.oangle
      rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C A, Orientation.oangle_sign_neg_right, neg_neg]
    rw [h6, h7, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rotate_sign A D C, h5, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rev C A B, Real.Angle.sign_neg,
      EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rotate_sign B C A, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rotate_sign A B C]
  have hoa := Orientation.oangle_eq_of_angle_eq_of_sign_eq _ h1 hsgn
  have hz := Orientation.oangle_add (Module.Oriented.positiveOrientation (R := ℝ) (M := V) (ι := Fin 2)) hu hv hw
  rw [hoa] at hz
  have hray := (Orientation.oangle_eq_zero_iff_sameRay _).mp (add_eq_right.mp hz)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrv⟩ := hray.exists_pos_left hu hv
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev, ← hrv]
  exact (Submodule.span_singleton_smul_eq (IsUnit.mk0 _ hr.ne') _).symm
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (A B C D E : P), Sbtw ℝ E A C → (line[ℝ, A, C]).SSameSide B D → EuclideanGeometry.angle E A B = EuclideanGeometry.angle A C D → (line[ℝ, A, B]).Parallel line[ℝ, C, D]
